cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Leave that letter under my plate. We only just managed breakfast together again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I've covered this month's rent. We don't need another suitcase in the hall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please finish breakfast with me first. Yesterday you finally unpacked; I can't risk you packing again.

mechanism: A denies permission to open a threatening letter while treating breakfast together as a fragile peace A must supervise.
confusable: D85 hides A own role while urgently repairing; D87 hides a truth because another conflict might end the connection.
comparison: A concealed repayment letter after unpacking differs from a bank inquiry about missing savings before an anniversary dinner.
seedUse: Use D87-a covered rent and recent unpacking to make the feared relational consequence explicit without claiming the letter contents independently verified.
